properties.name: A bounded reply shortens every list by the characters it costs, and compare_designs pages one list
properties.rationale: The budget module's own rule is that a shorter answer is never a quieter one, and its list sampling honoured it for the one-list replies it was written on (detect_gaps, topic_report), where the longest list by count is also the one costing the most. A diff of two unrelated designs has several long id lists, so the single-list sampler could never bring it under budget, and the reply the budget note itself says a client refuses was still sent: the client refused it, and the caller saw nothing. The class fix is to shorten by cost across every list in one place, and to give the one tool whose lists ARE the answer a page, so a shortened diff always has a way to the rest. Lists nested inside another list's elements are deliberately never shortened. The hint for the follow-up call lives in words in budget.note rather than as a per-list call object, because adding keys after bounding would push the reply past the budget. chars_of still measures UTF-8 bytes, as before. properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Measured on flo2.io 2026-10-11 (fact:compare-designs-by-graph-id-on-two-unrelated-designs-replies-1-4-m-chars-against-a-4000-budget-2026-10-11): compare_designs flo2 vs reflow2 with budget_chars 4000 replied 1,421,523 characters. Cause, confirmed by two unit tests failing first in reply_budget.rs: bound_reply_with under Sampling::Allowed shortened ONE list, the one longest_array found by element count, halved it to one entry and left every other list whole (two 4,000-row id lists against a 2,000 budget came back 63,662 chars); and the reply was measured without its own `budget` block (1,582 chars against 1,500). Fix in reply_budget.rs alone, so every Sampling::Allowed tool gets it: after the prose rungs, every list reachable through object keys gives by the characters it costs, a heap taking one tail entry at a time from the list currently costing the most, down to a floor of one entry, re-measuring the assembled reply with its block each round until it fits; the block gains lists_shortened [{path, shown, total}], the note names each list, a reply still over with every list at its floor says so, and reply_chars equals the reply as sent (prose-only trims also now stop at the first rung where body + block fits). The Forbidden path is untouched and every earlier reply_budget test passes unchanged. compare_designs gains optional `list` (one of the nine diff paths: design.added/removed/changed, supporting.added/removed/changed, edges_added/removed/changed, as an enum held in enum_schema::DIFF_LISTS) and `offset`: the page reply carries page {list, offset, total, shown, next_offset, complete}, items, counts (every list's length) and summary; refusals for an unknown list, offset without list, offset past the end. A shortened compare reply's budget note tells the caller that call (the path and its shown as offset). Measured through --call on a probe: budget 3,000, full 7,969, reply 2,962 with design.added 10 of 80 and edges_added 9 of 40; paging edges_added across two pages concatenates to the unbudgeted list in order, every page within budget (new test in a_cross_design_read_takes_the_other_design_by_graph_id.rs, 7 pass). Toolsnap compare_designs.json regenerated (197 match, invariants pass); the surface-only-grows fixture untouched (optional fields only); description 1,035 chars.
